text:
maya: Quick sync — can we pick a slot for the inference perf readout (latency + cost)? Need to finalize agenda and who presents. Target next Wed/Thu. 30m. :calendar:

ton y: Wed morning works for me, prefer earlier (PT). Can we do 10:30 PT?

sara: Thu is okay for me but I can reshuffle. I can take latency slides if needed.

kevin: I can prep the infra notes (batching/kv cache config) and run an extra 2k-seq test if we confirm slot.

elena: From PM side, please include a short "user impact" summary + any regressions vs last release. 2 slides max.

bench-bot: Auto-post: latest nightly run (1782010000) summary:
- model: redwood-13b-4bit
- seq: 1024
- batch: 4
- p50: 115ms, p95: 430ms
- token-cost: $0.00092
Details: <https://redwood.dashboard/runs/1782010000> :bar_chart:

maya: thanks bench-bot. Kevin can you run the 2048-seq variant? we'll want that in the readout.

kevin: yup. Queuing now. Command I'm running for reproducibility:
```
./bench/run_inference.sh --model redwood-13b-4bit --seq 2048 --batch 8 --trials 30 --metrics p50,p95,cost
```
Should have results in ~25m.

tony: I'll add a cost per-kernel breakdown slide from the profiler (nvprof -> kernel table). Also can add an example fallback policy impact (if heavy tail hits).

maya: Agenda proposal (30m):
1) Quick context & goals (2m)
2) Latency readout (10m) — sara + kevin
3) Cost + kernel breakdown (8m) — tony
4) Rollout recommendations + action items (7m)

elena: LGTM. Also: call out any observable correctness diffs from quantization tests.

bench-bot: Run 1782103600 completed:
- model: redwood-13b-4bit
- seq: 2048
- p50: 220ms, p95: 980ms
- token-cost: $0.0018
Quick note: p95 is dominated by cache-miss cases on long contexts.

sara: wow p95 is higher than I expected. Can we include a histogram of tail latencies? Even a 1-slide plot is fine.

kevin: I'll capture the tail histogram and attach raw csv to the readout doc. Also will annotate which runs had cache warmup.

maya: Who will present the recommendation? (can be 1-2 people)

ton y: I can cover cost + rollback knobs.

sara: I'll do latency + histogram and highlight mitigations.

maya: OK locking slot: Wed 10:30 PT -> 30m. I'll create calendar invite and attach the doc.

elena: Please add acceptance criteria for rollout (p95 < 700ms on typical 1024 seq, cost delta < 15%).

maya: noted. Action items:
- kevin: attach raw csv + histogram (due before meeting)
- sara: prepare latency slides (2) + presenter notes
- tony: cost breakdown slide + profiler table
- bench-bot: link to final runs in doc (automated)

maya: If anyone needs more data points (different batch sizes / model variants) shout now, otherwise we'll proceed with these runs. :thumbsup:

kevin: running a couple more batches (batch 4/8/16) now. Will post links when done.

sara: thanks all — I'll start the deck.

maya: invite sent. See you Wed 10:30 PT.
